basic_profile.bio: Alex, a 45-year-old software developer hailing from Knoxville, Tennessee. Passionate about gaming, especially Pokémon and strategy games like backgammon. When not coding or gaming, Alex enjoys quiet weekends in Gatlinburg and exploring new hiking trails. Widowed for two years, they find solace in online communities and have recently taken an interest in the world of unicorn swingers. Usually online late at night due to a flexible work schedule. Proud pet parent to two cats, Luna and Shadow.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Alex holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and has over two decades of experience in software development. A lifelong learner, they have self-taught many programming languages and are currently exploring game development. Their expertise extends to gaming strategies, particularly in Pokémon and classic board games like backgammon.
